services.name: Skydio Cloud

services.connector: Reference only — no vendor telemetry connector enabled
services.useful: Agency operators can check the official integration prerequisites and device groups; this catalog does not connect to their account.

services.name: Axon Air / Respond
services.data: Drone video alongside body-camera streams for authorized responders.
services.access: Configured customer integration.
services.gap: Current tenant endpoints and live flight records are not published by this source.
services.connector: Reference only — no vendor telemetry connector enabled

services.name: DedroneBeyond

services.access: Operator system; no public telemetry access verified.
services.gap: This publication does not establish MQTT endpoints, RF fingerprints or a public track API.
services.connector: Reference only — no vendor telemetry connector enabled
services.useful: Useful context for identifying sensor inputs; this source does not provide an importable public track feed.

services.name: Axon 911 Core / integrations

services.name: DJI Cloud API

services.access: Gateway registered with the customer platform and its configured authentication.

services.name: Orbit / Spot

services.gap: Platform API documentation does not reveal deployed units, device radio signatures or public locations.
services.connector: Reference only — no vendor telemetry connector enabled

services.name: MiR Fleet
